쿠팡은 고객 감동 실현을 위해 존재합니다. 고객들이 "쿠팡 없이 그동안 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말할 때, 비로소 우리의 미션을 실현하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 고객들의 쇼핑과 식사, 생활 전반을 편하게 만들겠다는 유일한 집념으로 쿠팡은 수억 달러 규모의 커머스 산업 전반의 혁신을 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡은 가장 빠르게 성장하는 리테일 기업 중 하나로, 국내 커머스 업계에서의 독보적인 입지와, 고객 신뢰를 구축했습니다.

쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 유지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는 여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다.

쿠팡의 모든 직원은 커머스의 미래를 만들겠다는 쿠팡의 미션에 진심입니다. 우리는 고객의 문제를 해결해 나가고, 전통적인 관념과 통념에 맞서며 실현가능한 한계를 뛰어넘고 있습니다. 고가용성 (Always-on) 과 최첨단의 앞선 기술 (High-tech), 초연결사회 (Hyper-connected world) 에서의 놀라운 업무 경험을 원하신다면, 지금 바로 쿠팡에 합류하세요.

직무소개

쿠팡 통번역사는 전세계 쿠팡 직원들이 성공적으로 협업하고, 세계 최고 수준의 지식 기반을 구축할 수 있게 통번역을 지원하고 있습니다. 쿠팡은 통번역사를 단순한 서포트 역할로 생각하지 않습니다. 쿠팡 통번역사들은 다양한 조직의 비즈니스에 깊게 관여하며, 직원들 각자가 편한 언어를 사용하면서 최고의 성과를 만들 수 있도록 하는 중추적인 역할을 하고 있습니다.

Clare, Ireland Lead Operations. Develop People. Drive Performance. At RTX, 185,000 talented people are united by a shared purpose: solving some of the world’s most complex challenges and helping to shape the future of aerospace and defence. Collins Aerospace, an RTX business, is a leader in technologically advanced and intelligent solutions for the global aerospace and defence industry. Across our worldwide operations, we combine deep technical expertise, innovation and operational excellence to help keep the world moving safely and reliably. We are now looking for an experienced Operations Leader to optimise performance at our Collins Aerospace Aftermarket site in Shannon . This is a key site leadership position reporting to the General Manager / Accountable Manager, with responsibility for the safe, compliant and efficient operation of the repair station, alongside oversight of site facilities and auditing of the monthly shop floor bonus scheme. Working closely with a team of Production Supervisors, you will create an environment in which our people can perform at their best while delivering against our commitments in Product Safety, Quality, Delivery, Cost and Employee Engagement . If you are an experienced operations leader who enjoys developing people, improving processes and turning operational challenges into measurable results, this is an opportunity to make a significant impact in a leading company within a growing industry. What You Will Do Lead and Develop Team Members You will provide visible, hands-on leadership across the repair operation, creating a culture built around accountability, collaboration, respect and continuous improvement. You will: Take responsibility for repair personnel and collaborate with other functions to support the site’s performance and business targets. Deputise for the Workshop Manager when required. Build a high-performing and highly engaged culture where people feel empowered to contribute, challenge and improve. Set clear expectations and drive accountability for operational performance within your area of responsibility. Identify talent and development needs, creating opportunities for professional growth across the team. Maintain the competence of maintenance personnel by continually identifying training gaps and ensuring appropriate skill sets are maintained. Ensure accurate and timely submission of team time records across your area of responsibility. Own Operational Performance You will be responsible for achieving output, quality, efficiency and safety targets within your area of responsibility. You will: Develop and execute production plans within your area of responsibility. Drive performance against key measures, including on-time delivery, quality, productivity and cost . Monitor and analyse operational KPIs, identifying trends, risks and opportunities for improvement. Forecast resource, capacity and capability requirements to support production demand and future growth. Drive disciplined execution of daily Lean management, including tiered accountability meetings, visual management and leader standard work. Take prompt corrective action where performance falls short of plan. Audit the monthly shop floor bonus scheme, verifying supporting performance data and calculations against the agreed scheme criteria, resolving discrepancies with relevant stakeholders and maintaining clear records to support accurate and timely payment. Oversee Site Facilities You will oversee day-to-day facilities management at the Shannon site, ensuring the workplace and supporting infrastructure enable safe, reliable and efficient operations. You will: Coordinate planned maintenance, repairs and upkeep of the building, utilities and supporting site infrastructure. Liaise with external contractors and service providers, coordinating work to minimise disruption to repair operations. Work closely with EHS, Quality and other relevant functions to ensure facilities activities meet applicable safety requirements and company procedures. Monitor facilities issues, prioritise corrective actions and escalate risks, expenditure requirements and infrastructure needs to the General Manager. Champion Continuous Improvement Continuous improvement will be central to your leadership approach. You will take ownership of CORE continuous improvement initiatives , creating and sustaining an improvement strategy aligned with the wider objectives of Collins Aerospace and RTX. You will: Identify, prioritise and deliver continuous improvement projects across the operation. Use Lean and CI methodologies, including Value Stream Mapping, Kaizen and Root Cause Analysis . Work cross-functionally to remove bottlenecks, eliminate waste and streamline repair and production processes. Engage employees at all levels in identifying and implementing better ways of working. Track the impact of improvement initiatives against agreed KPIs. Deliver measurable improvements in productivity, quality, cost and operational performance. Lead improvement events using the company’s continuous improvement programme, CORE. You will be a change leader , bringing people with you as you implement improvement projects and initiatives. Put Safety, Quality and Compliance First Operating within a regulated aerospace environment means safety, quality and compliance are fundamental to everything we do. Within your area of responsibility, you will ensure maintenance standards are achieved in accordance with Part 145.A.65 and approved maintenance data. Your responsibilities will include: Ensuring compliance with safety standards, regulatory requirements and company policies. Maintaining a strong, proactive safety culture across the operation. Ensuring the correct handling, identification and tagging of parts and units throughout the repair process. Ensuring tools are appropriately controlled, segregated, preserved and maintained in serviceable condition. Maintaining documentation integrity and ensuring maintenance entries, forms and work orders are correctly completed. Ensuring continuity of repair activity when personnel, shifts or assignments change. Ensuring satisfactory completion of customer work in accordance with approved data, procedures and quality standards. Completing agreed corrective actions arising from Quality Audits within required timescales. Deliver for Our Customers Our customers depend on us for quality, reliability and delivery. You will work closely with Quality, Engineering and other cross-functional partners to ensure we consistently meet those commitments. You will help build a culture where teams understand the connection between their everyday decisions and the experience we provide to our customers, ensuring work is completed safely, compliantly, efficiently and to the highest quality standards. Help Shape the Future of the Shannon Operation Beyond today’s operational requirements, you will work with senior leadership to help shape the site’s future. You will contribute to strategic planning, capacity and resource forecasting, and operational improvement, ensuring the Shannon operation is positioned to respond to changing customer requirements and future growth opportunities. What You Will Bring We are looking for an established operations leader who combines strong people leadership with a passion for operational excellence. Ideally, you will bring: A Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Operations Management, Business Administration or a related discipline. An advanced degree would be advantageous. 8+ years’ experience in production or operations management within aerospace, manufacturing, MedTech or another highly regulated environment. Proven experience leading, coaching and developing high-performing operational teams. Strong experience delivering continuous improvement within a manufacturing, production or repair environment . Practical knowledge of Lean and CI methodologies, with evidence of delivering measurable improvements in cost, productivity, quality or delivery. Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt certification would be advantageous. Strong project management capability and experience delivering improvement programmes from concept through to implementation. Excellent analytical, problem-solving and decision-making skills. The ability to communicate, influence and build effective relationships across different functions and levels of an organisation. Strong SAP and Microsoft Office skills. This is an opportunity to take on a highly visible operational leadership role within one of the world's leading aerospace and defence organisations. You will have the scope to lead people, influence site performance, strengthen operational capability and drive meaningful change , while working within a global organisation that continues to invest in technology, people and continuous improvement. At Collins Aerospace, the challenge is not simply to keep operations moving. It is to keep making them better. Join us in Shannon and help shape the future of aerospace.
